title: Original adaptation texts, writer compensation and delivered support

writer_compensation.question: Can original adaptation payments be established, and can practical writer-support routes strengthen the existing discussion?

queries: Odia author film adaptation rights royalty payment Gourahari Das Bapa
Pratibha Ray Yajnaseni film rights payment
routes.result: No original contract, payment receipt or attributable author account of an adaptation fee established. Prior Pratikshya remake token concerns filmmaker remake rights, not the source author. Book royalties, actor fees and recording-royalty disputes are not substituted for literary-adaptation payments.

routes.access: Direct web open returns JavaScript shell. Targeted search index returns the full official FAQ, dated 2016/2017; current official homepage separately lists legal-counsel appointments exclusively for members.
routes.finding: SWA describes free member guidance on contracts and copyright; its legal officer does not draft members’ contracts.
routes.limit: General institutional support, not proof of any Odia writer’s fee or universal legal entitlement.

routes.type: Rights association original eligibility and terms
routes.access: Direct official page read, lines 5–8, 73–78 and membership conditions. No form submitted.
routes.finding: Eligibility includes qualifying story/screenplay/dialogue credits in any language. Terms explicitly say membership does not mean immediate royalties.
routes.limit: No payment to an Odia author is established. Eligibility depends on the published conditions; no blanket assertion that every novelist qualifies.

sources.claim: Member advice on contracts and copyright, no contract drafting
Member-only legal counsel; association explicitly says it has not officially issued a minimum rate card
sources.access: Official search-index page, current footer 2026; direct open JS shell

sources.claim: Eligible credited screenwriters in any language; membership does not mean immediate royalty payments

rejected_inferences: No records found does not establish nonpayment or unfair treatment.
Book royalties and film remake rights are not original literary-adaptation fees.
Third-party minimum-rate cards are not adopted; official SWA homepage disclaims an officially issued minimum rate card.
Association membership is not proof of payment or automatic eligibility for every prose author.
writer_compensation.proposed_addition: Writers need not approach these conversations alone. The Screenwriters Association offers its members guidance on contracts and copyright. The Screenwriters Rights Association of India accepts applications from eligible writers with story, screenplay or dialogue credits in any language; its terms make clear that joining does not mean immediate royalty payments. These are practical places to explore while writers and producers work out how a particular story will travel.
